clue.text: Rank detectives originally managed

indicators.note: originally says this piece comes first, at the origin of the word, though printed last

parts.note: managed, in the sense of ran a business
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, the detective branch of British police

explanation.surface: A report on detectives who were once in charge of things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' says the piece for 'managed' comes first, even though it is printed after 'detectives'.
explanation.definitionFit: Rank as an adjective describes a foul, stale smell or taste, which is what spoiled fat gives off.

clue.text: A second son for the prophet

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a second, as in 'wait a mo'
S is the standard abbreviation for son in family trees

explanation.surface: A family where a second son is destined to become a prophet.
explanation.definitionFit: Amos is an Old Testament prophet with a book of the Bible named after him.

clue.text: A number stay calm in disaster and upheaval

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a number

indicators.note: an upheaval throws things into disorder, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Advice to a crowd to keep their heads during catastrophe and turmoil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upheaval' looks like part of the definition beside 'disaster', but it is the signal to rearrange C plus STAYCALM.
explanation.definitionFit: A cataclysm is a sudden violent catastrophe, a synonym for a great disaster.

clue.text: Plans for men on board, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the word is judged by how it is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: draughts are the pieces of the board game draughts (checkers in the US)

explanation.surface: Arrangements for the crew of a ship, or so it is rumoured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'men on board' suggests a ship's crew; it means the pieces in the game of draughts, called checkers in America.
explanation.definitionFit: Drafts are preliminary versions or outline sketches, so they serve as plans.

clue.text: Soldier lacking papers? Very suspicious!

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper, a soldier
with no ID, no identity documents

explanation.surface: A soldier found without his documents is viewed with deep suspicion.
explanation.definitionFit: Paranoid describes someone excessively distrustful of others, extremely suspicious.

clue.text: Took firm action to speed things up

definitions.meaning: to insist firmly and refuse to back down
a driver presses the accelerator to the floor to go faster

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means both to assert authority firmly and, for a driver, to accelerate hard.

clue.text: Oven ring used outside for cooking

indicators.note: used outside says the ring surrounds the other piece

parts.note: taken as written
an oast is a kiln, an oven for drying hops

explanation.surface: A cook placing a ring around the oven while preparing food.
explanation.walkthrough: An oast is a kiln for drying hops, a familiar sight in Kent as oast houses; 'used outside' wraps the ring round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Roasting is a method of cooking food by dry heat in an oven.

clue.text: Eric goes out, heading north to be more exact

indicators.note: heading puts this piece at the head of the word
goes out suggests the letters of the name are thrown out of order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Eric leaves, setting off northwards in search of greater precision.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes out' scrambles the name, and 'heading' puts the compass letter at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Nice can mean fine or precise, as in a nice distinction, so nicer means more exact.

clue.text: Being dressed as a priest should pay dividends

definitions.meaning: read as two words: wearing a priest's robe, a vestment
money put into shares in the hope of returns

explanation.walkthrough: The first definition splits the answer into IN plus VESTMENT, a priest's ceremonial robe.
explanation.definitionFit: An investment is a stake of money expected to yield returns such as dividends.

clue.text: Pick up a bargain

definitions.meaning: to catch an illness, as in picking up a cold

explanation.definitionFit: Contract as a verb means to catch a disease, and as a noun a binding agreement or deal.

clue.text: In retreat, Capone stood at bay

parts.note: Al Capone, the Chicago gangster
a cove is a small sheltered bay

explanation.surface: A gangster hiding out, Al Capone cornered by his pursuers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stood at bay' evokes a cornered quarry; 'bay' is the coastal inlet.
explanation.definitionFit: An alcove is a recess in a wall, a small secluded nook to retreat into.

clue.text: Score with awkward truths in clever argument

parts.note: to score is to cut a line into a surface
and means with, together with

indicators.note: awkward suggests the letters are clumsily jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Winning a debate by producing some uncomfortable facts.
explanation.definitionFit: Cut and thrust, from swordplay, is the lively exchange of argument in debate.

clue.text: Atrocious football team at home with no score against us

parts.note: Aston Villa, the Birmingham football club, is often just Villa
in means at home, as in staying in
O is zero, nil, no score
taken as written

explanation.surface: A football report: the home side failing to score against us was dreadful.
explanation.walkthrough: Aston Villa is an English Premier League football club based in Birmingham.
explanation.definitionFit: Villainous means wicked or criminal, hence atrocious in behaviour.

clue.text: It is fitting amidst extremes of penury

definitions.text: It is fitting amidst extremes of penury

indicators.note: fitting amidst says this piece is set into the middle of another
extremes of picks the first and last letters of the word

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A remark that compassion is the right response to people in poverty.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: compassion is the fitting response to the destitute.
explanation.definitionFit: Pity is compassion for suffering, the feeling poverty properly calls for.

clue.text: Some symptoms of an extremely silly modern disorder

indicators.note: extremely picks the letters at the extremes, first and last
disorder says the letters are put out of order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Doctors puzzling over the symptoms of a ridiculous new illness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disorder' looks like part of the medical picture, but it is the signal to scramble 'modern'.
explanation.definitionFit: A syndrome is a group of symptoms that occur together as a recognised condition.

clue.text: Once rises develop on the stock market it may disappear

definitions.text: Once rises develop on the stock market it may disappear

indicators.note: develop suggests the letters grow into a new form

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A market commentator predicting a downturn will vanish once share prices climb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'develop' rearranges ONCE RISES, and the whole clue describes an economic slump ending when markets rise.
explanation.definitionFit: A recession is a period of economic decline that ends once markets recover.

clue.text: Smokes and produces an angry reaction

definitions.meaning: perfumes with fragrant smoke, as burning joss sticks do

explanation.definitionFit: To incense is both to perfume with burning incense and to enrage someone.

clue.text: Sweetheart joins sergeant in dance

parts.note: an old flame is a former sweetheart
a sergeant is an NCO, a non-commissioned officer

explanation.surface: A soldier's girlfriend partners him on the dance floor.
explanation.definitionFit: Flamenco is a passionate Spanish dance style from Andalusia.

clue.text: List of slang

definitions.meaning: a tilt or lean, as a ship lists
the jargon of a particular group

explanation.definitionFit: Cant means both a slope or tilt and the special jargon of a group.

clue.text: Great fun for sadists?

parts.note: something hilarious, and also the shriek of pain that a sadist would enjoy

explanation.definitionFit: Informally, a hilarious experience is called a laugh or a riot; sadists enjoy their victims' cries.

clue.text: Bows and scrapes to obtain indications of approval

parts.note: to fiddle is to scrape away at a violin
ticks are marks showing something is right

explanation.surface: A courtier bowing and scraping to win a nod of approval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bows and scrapes' looks like an idiom of servility; 'Bows' alone is the definition, violin bows.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiddlestick is the bow used to play a fiddle, so the plural means bows.

clue.text: Sort of lead mother will follow in principle

indicators.note: will follow places this piece after the other

parts.note: a dog lead is a kind of lead
ma is a familiar word for mother

explanation.surface: Mum will tag along behind whoever takes the lead, on principle.
explanation.definitionFit: Dogma is a principle or set of tenets laid down as incontrovertibly true.

clue.text: Offbeat classical character

parts.note: a Greek letter whose letters are those of beat jumbled, put off

explanation.walkthrough: Offbeat hints that the letters of BEAT are knocked out of place; a classical character is a Greek letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Beta is the second letter of the Greek alphabet, a character of classical Greek.

clue.text: Sought out hooligans

indicators.note: out signals the letters are thrown out of order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Toughs are rough, violent young men, the same as hooligans or thugs.

clue.text: Biased team and what may be done about it

definitions.text: team and what may be done about it
definitions.meaning: a single team, one side, and the act of taking its side

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is playful: one side is a team, and siding with it is what partisans do.
explanation.definitionFit: One-sided means partial or biased, favouring one party over another.

clue.text: When special forces transgress with killer

parts.note: as means when, as in 'as I arrived'
SAS is the Special Air Service, Britain's special forces regiment
to sin is to transgress

explanation.surface: Commandos who break the rules teaming up with a hitman.
explanation.definitionFit: An assassin is a murderer, especially one who kills a prominent person.

clue.text: Crazy lament?

indicators.note: crazy says the letters are jumbled wildly

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A mournful song that has gone off its head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crazy' rearranges LAMENT, and the question mark flags that a crazy-looking lament is itself the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Mental is informal for mad or crazy.
